correctness.rationale: For \(4n\) explicitly labelled spins, the exchange and field normalization give the exact identity \(H/J=(10-4x)n+2\sum_i[r_i^2+(x-6)r_i]+4\sum_i|S_i\cap S_{i+1}|\). At \(x=3\) or \(x=5\) the two exact sums of nonnegative integer terms characterize all equality states and prove attainable energies. The 10-state disjoint-subset transfer matrix has a proved block diagonalization \(2+6+2\), giving the claimed spectral factors, all-n degeneracies and magnetization polynomial. A simple positive Perron root yields the two entropy limits; its analytic deformation provides the nondegenerate Gaussian law with derivatives \(\mu=1/2+\sqrt7/14\) and variance \(3\sqrt7/49\). Interpolated energy bounds classify \(3<x<5\) and \(x>5\). Independent original-Hamiltonian DP, subset transfer, small-size brute force and spectral recurrences all pass 163 supplementary exact checks. Proved assertions \(n\ge3\); experiments are not substituted for proof.

value.rationale: This is a natural field-driven frustrated antiferromagnet on the complete tetrahedral-rung periodic tube for every period, not an arbitrary parameter slice. The boundary \(h=3J\) is selected by competing balanced and half-polarized ground regimes; it produces a nontrivial constrained 10-state ensemble with a full exact magnetization polynomial, entropy base \(2+\sqrt7\), a positive and explicit Gaussian fluctuation coefficient, and a parity effect in the least-polarized sector. The saturation boundary \(h=5J\) has a different entropy base \(2+\sqrt5\), and all high-field phases are sharply classified. These results give physically interpretable coexistence entropy and magnetization fluctuations not implied by a single small-size count, beyond an off-the-shelf transfer formula.
